name: agents-studio
description: A workbench for Claude Code — run several sessions at once, each on its own branch, put recurring work on a schedule, and see what everything cost.
author: David Rodriguez Pozo
//: Only the built server and its launcher ship. The build is self-contained — Nitro vendors dependencies into .output/server/node_modules — so an install has nothing to resolve and nothing to compile.
//dependencies: There are deliberately none. Nitro vendors what the server needs into .output/server/node_modules, so a published install resolves nothing, compiles nothing, and does not drag Nuxt and the whole build toolchain onto a machine that only wants to run the thing. Everything below is needed to build it, which makes it a dev dependency by definition. `prepare` rather than `postinstall` for the same reason: postinstall would run on a user's machine and fail looking for nuxt.
